copy_basis: Task names from the authenticated document coverage table; concise English briefs from those names and inspection of supplied video frames. Detailed per-level thresholds have not been imported.

cases.title: Object-Code Keypad Entry
cases.summary: Remember entity–value associations, decode the physical expression, and enter its exact result on the keypad.
cases.instruction: Observe and remember the object–digit pairs. After the display changes, read the object sequence from left to right and enter its digits on the keypad, pressing and releasing each key in order.

instructions.easy: Observe the visible entity-value associations, remember them, decode the physical expression, and enter its exact result using only the closed gripper fingertips on the nine keys.
instructions.medium: Observe the visible entity-value associations, remember them, decode the physical expression, and enter its exact result using only the closed gripper fingertips on the nine keys.
instructions.hard: Observe the visible entity-value associations, remember them, decode the physical expression, and enter its exact result using only the closed gripper fingertips on the nine keys.

cases.title: Color-Block Trial Ordering
cases.summary: Use feedback from trial arrangements to determine the required order of colored blocks.
cases.instruction: Arrange the colored blocks, inspect the displayed feedback, and revise the ordering until the required arrangement is reached.

instructions.easy: Place one colored block in each slot, then press and release the confirmation button on the right. The brief feedback gives the number of correct positions. Infer the hidden permutation in as few attempts as possible.
instructions.medium: Place one colored block in each slot, then press and release the confirmation button on the right. The brief feedback gives the number of correct positions. Infer the hidden permutation in as few attempts as possible.
instructions.hard: Place one colored block in each slot, then press and release the confirmation button on the right. The brief feedback gives the number of correct positions. Infer the hidden permutation in as few attempts as possible.

cases.title: Steamer Stack Order Reconstruction
cases.summary: Remember a stack arrangement and reconstruct the order of the steamer components.
cases.instruction: Observe the initial steamer arrangement, retain its order, and reconstruct the stack after the reference is no longer available.

instructions.easy: Remove the lid, remember the dim sum order as you unstack the baskets from top to bottom onto the mats, then restack them in the same order from bottom to top on the left steamer pot and replace the lid.
instructions.medium: Remove the lid, remember the dim sum order as you unstack the baskets from top to bottom onto the mats, then restack them in the same order from bottom to top on the left steamer pot and replace the lid.
instructions.hard: Remove the lid, remember the dim sum order as you unstack the baskets from top to bottom onto the mats, then restack them in the same order from bottom to top on the left steamer pot and replace the lid without using any distractor baskets.

cases.title: Hidden-Zone Navigation
cases.summary: Remember hidden restricted cells and guide a marker across the grid toward the goal.
cases.instruction: Observe the restricted cells when they are shown. Use the movement controls to guide the marker to the goal while avoiding the remembered restricted areas.

instructions.easy: Remember the briefly lit forbidden cells. Press and release the arrow buttons to move one cell per press. Reach the ring without entering a forbidden cell or leaving the board. Do not touch the slider.
instructions.medium: Remember the briefly lit forbidden cells. Press and release the arrow buttons to move one cell per press. Reach the ring without entering a forbidden cell or leaving the board. Do not touch the slider.
instructions.hard: Remember the briefly lit forbidden cells. Press and release the arrow buttons to move one cell per press. Reach the ring without entering a forbidden cell or leaving the board. Do not touch the slider.

cases.title: Memory Card Matching
cases.summary: Remember revealed card identities and locations to find matching pairs.
cases.instruction: Reveal cards, remember their identities and positions, and use that history to select matching pairs.

instructions.easy: Press and release a card's yellow button to turn it face up, revealing at most two unmatched cards at a time. Matching pictures stay face up; mismatches turn face down automatically. Wait until the flip or pair result finishes before selecting another card. Remember the pictures and their positions and match every pair.
instructions.medium: Press and release a card's yellow button to turn it face up, revealing at most two unmatched cards at a time. Matching pictures stay face up; mismatches turn face down automatically. Wait until the flip or pair result finishes before selecting another card. Remember the pictures and their positions and match every pair.
instructions.hard: Press and release a card's yellow button to turn it face up, revealing at most two unmatched cards at a time. Matching pictures stay face up; mismatches turn face down automatically. Wait until the flip or pair result finishes before selecting another card. Remember the pictures and their positions and match every pair.

cases.title_zh: 方巾折边对齐与稳定落放
cases.title: Cloth Edge Alignment and Placement
cases.summary: Fold and align a cloth edge, then release it in a stable placement.
cases.instruction: Manipulate the cloth to align the required edges, complete the fold, and release the cloth onto the support surface.

instructions.easy: Fold the square cloth along its centerline into the displayed rectangle, release it fully and leave it flat and stable.
instructions.medium: Fold the square cloth diagonally into the displayed triangle, release it fully and leave it flat and stable.
instructions.hard: Fold the hexagonal cloth once into the displayed trapezoid, align its paired edges, release it fully and leave it stable.

cases.title: Oriented Stamp Placement
cases.summary: Orient a stamp and press it onto the designated area.
cases.instruction: Grasp the stamp, align its orientation with the indicated reference, press it onto the target area, and lift it away.

instructions.easy: Pick up square stamp A and stamp once, fully inside the blue box, with its arrow aligned to the target arrow. Do not drag or stamp twice. Return the stamp to its holder in its original orientation and release it.
instructions.medium: Pick up square stamp A and stamp once, fully inside the blue box, with its arrow aligned to the target arrow. Do not drag or stamp twice. Return the stamp to its holder in its original orientation and release it.
instructions.hard: Pick up square stamp A and stamp once, fully inside the blue box, with its arrow aligned to the target arrow. Do not drag or stamp twice. Return the stamp to its holder in its original orientation and release it.

cases.title: Domino Chain Bell Ringing
cases.summary: Arrange dominoes into a chain that carries a falling motion to the bell.
cases.instruction: Place the dominoes along the indicated route, then initiate the chain so that the final action reaches the bell.

instructions.easy: Stand the dominos anywhere inside the continuous curve band, in order along the curve. Push the first one so the chain of contacts rings the bell. Repair fallen or stalled segments using as few pushes as possible.
instructions.medium: Stand the dominos anywhere inside the continuous curve band, in order along the curve. Push the first one so the chain of contacts rings the bell. Repair fallen or stalled segments using as few pushes as possible.
instructions.hard: Stand the dominos anywhere inside the continuous curve band, in order along the curve. Push the first one so the chain of contacts rings the bell. Repair fallen or stalled segments using as few pushes as possible.

cases.title_zh: 周期挡门穿越与及时撤离
cases.title: Periodic Gate Crossing and Withdrawal
cases.summary: Time the arm’s movement through a periodically moving gate and withdraw safely.
cases.instruction: Observe the gate cycle, move through the opening to reach the target, and withdraw before the gate obstructs the passage.

instructions.easy: Grasp the eraser, time the moving gate, and pass through its opening to place the eraser stably in the green tray behind it. Withdraw the whole gripper before the gate closes. Do not touch the gate, frame or rails.
instructions.medium: Grasp the eraser, time the moving gate, and pass through its opening to place the eraser stably in the green tray behind it. Withdraw the whole gripper before the gate closes. Do not touch the gate, frame or rails.
instructions.hard: Grasp the eraser, time the moving gates, and pass through the blue then the orange opening to place the eraser stably in the green tray behind them. Withdraw the whole gripper past the outer gate before they close. Do not touch any gate, frame or rail.

cases.title_zh: 托盘带球搬运与稳定落放
cases.title: Ball-on-Tray Transport and Placement
cases.summary: Carry a tray with a ball while controlling tilt, then place it on the destination surface.
cases.instruction: Lift and transport the tray while keeping the ball supported. Lower the tray onto the destination surface and release it stably.

instructions.easy: Carry the tray with two balls by its handle to the delivery platform, keeping each ball inside its marked circle. Set the tray down stably, release it and retreat. Do not touch the balls or hit other objects.
instructions.medium: Carry the tray of balls by its handle from START to DESTINATION around the column, keeping each ball inside its marked circle. Set the tray down stably, release it and retreat. Do not touch the balls or hit anything.
instructions.hard: Carry the tray of four balls by its handle from START to DESTINATION around the two staggered columns, keeping each ball inside its marked circle. Set the tray down stably, release it and retreat. Do not touch the balls or hit anything.

cases.title: Produce Weighing and Balancing
cases.summary: Use the balance scale’s feedback to select and adjust counterweights for produce.
cases.instruction: Place the produce on the scale, observe its balance, and adjust the counterweights in response to the scale’s feedback.

instructions.easy: Move all fruit and vegetables from the left tray onto the left scale pan. Use the weights on the right to balance the scale, then release them and keep the pointer in the green zone.
instructions.medium: With the empty scale stable, press ZERO. Move all fruit and vegetables from the left tray onto the left scale pan. Use the weights on the right to balance the scale, then release them and keep the pointer in the green zone.
instructions.hard: With the empty scale stable, press ZERO. Move all fruit and vegetables from the left tray onto the left scale pan. Balance the scale using the weights on the right and by physically moving the sliding weight, then release them and keep the pointer in the green zone.

cases.title: Bridge Construction
cases.summary: Construct a bridge across a gap using the available building pieces.
cases.instruction: Select and position the bridge pieces to connect the two sides of the gap, coordinating the construction sequence with the structure already in place.

instructions.easy: Build a stable bridge across the gap with continuous wheel paths on both sides. Release the bridge pieces, then press and release the button and let the car drive across to the opposite bank.
instructions.medium: Build a stable bridge across the gap with continuous wheel paths on both sides. Choose suitable pieces by shape and size from the stock, which includes extra blocks, and leave unused blocks aside. Release the bridge pieces, then press and release the button and let the car drive across to the opposite bank.
instructions.hard: Build a stable bridge across the gap with continuous wheel paths on both sides. Choose suitable pieces by shape and size from the stock, which includes extra blocks, and leave unused blocks aside. Release the bridge pieces, then press and release the button and let the car drive across to the opposite bank.

cases.title: Reference-Guided Block Construction
cases.summary: Remember a reference structure and reproduce it with the available blocks.
cases.instruction: Observe the reference structure, retain the arrangement, and place the blocks to recreate it after the reference is hidden.

instructions.easy: Remember the briefly shown front view, then build the structure from memory, centred in the marked area and aligned with the table reference line. Fix any misplaced lower blocks. Use only reference-colour blocks and release everything.
instructions.medium: Remember the briefly shown front view, then build the structure from memory, centred in the marked area and aligned with the table reference line. Fix any misplaced lower blocks. Use only reference-colour blocks and release everything.
instructions.hard: Remember the briefly shown front view, then build the structure from memory, centred in the marked area and aligned with the table reference line. If the base is misplaced, move the beam above it aside and rebuild; put the roof ridge-up on the cylinders. Use only reference-colour blocks and release everything.

cases.title: Whiteboard Drawing Reconstruction
cases.summary: Recreate a reference drawing on a whiteboard using the available markers.
cases.instruction: Observe the reference drawing and reproduce its shapes and layout on the whiteboard, selecting and manipulating the required markers.

instructions.easy: Remember the briefly shown original drawing on the whiteboard. Erase the added strokes and redraw any original strokes you erased, so the board matches the original.
instructions.medium: Remember the briefly shown original drawing on the whiteboard. Erase the added strokes, uncap the pens of the colors needed, and redraw any original strokes you erased, so the board matches the original.
instructions.hard: Remember the briefly shown original drawing on the whiteboard. Erase the added strokes, uncap the pens of the colors needed, and redraw any original strokes you erased, so the board matches the original.

cases.title: Predictive Ball Return and Red-Ball Avoidance
cases.summary: Predict incoming ball motion, return target balls, and avoid red balls.
cases.instruction: Track the incoming balls and time the paddle to return target balls while avoiding contact with red balls.

instructions.easy: Predict each ball from the launcher's settled aim. After two practice balls, use the sliding blocker to return every white ball to the far net and let every red ball pass untouched into the near net. Wait for each ball to settle before the next shot.
instructions.medium: Predict each ball from the launcher's settled aim. After two practice balls, use the sliding blocker to return every white ball to the far net and let every red ball pass untouched into the near net. Wait for each ball to settle before the next shot.
instructions.hard: Predict each ball from the launcher's settled aim. After two practice balls, use the sliding blocker to return every white ball to the far net and let every red ball pass untouched into the near net. Wait for each ball to settle before the next shot.
